seedance-2.0.prompt: Two siblings in their early thirties stand on opposite sides of a small kitchen island at night. The sister, wearing a grey hoodie and hair tied back, speaks first with an urgent gesture. The brother, in a faded blue shirt with sleeves rolled up, interrupts before she finishes. They both stop, look at each other, and the sister laughs first; the brother follows, shoulders dropping. A single warm pendant light hangs directly above the island, with cool hallway light spilling in from the left and a half-washed stack of dishes behind them. Two-shot at chest height, slow push in that settles as they laugh, shallow depth of field, naturalistic apartment realism. Dialogue in double quotes, voices overlapping, no music. Keep both faces stable and distinct throughout. No subtitles, no watermark, no extra characters.
seedance-2.0.notes: Seedance 2.0 wants spoken lines in double quotes and a clear who-speaks-when order.
